name: I-TB (Tuberculosis)
tagline: Ukukhwehlela amaviki angu-2+? Hlola namuhla - ukwelashwa kumahhala.

urgent.heading: Kuyaphuthuma - bona umtholampilo kuleli sonto
urgent.primary_message: Ukukhwehlela isikhathi esingaphezu kwamaviki ama-2, ukukhwehlela igazi, ukujuluka kakhulu ebusuku, noma ukuncipha ngokushesha - fika emtholampilo. Ukuhlola kumahhala.
red_flags: Ukukhwehlela okuhlala isikhathi esingaphezu kwamaviki ama-2 - kuyakhiqiza noma komile
Ukujuluka ebusuku kujuluka isikhathi esingaphezu kwesonto
Ubuhlungu besifuba obuba bubi nakakhulu ngokuphefumula
Izingane ezinokukhwehlela okungapheli nokwehluleka ukukhula kahle

what_is_it.heading: I-TB ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Isifo sofuba isifo sofuba esibangelwa yi-Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Ngokuvamile lihlasela amaphaphu kodwa lingathinta noma iyiphi ingxenye yomzimba - amathambo, ubuchopho, izinso, ama-lymph nodes.
paragraphs: I-TB isakazeka ngomoya lapho umuntu onaleli gciwane ekhwehlela noma ethimula. Abantu abaningi abadaluliwe abaguli ngokushesha - amagciwane angahlala iminyaka engasebenzi (i-TB equbisile) ngaphambi kokuba aqale ukusebenza. Cishe isifo esisodwa kweziyi-10 esicashile siba isifo esisebenzayo empilweni yonke.

I-TB iyelapheka. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile yizinyanga eziyisi-6 zamaphilisi nsuku zonke - mahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ingozi enkulu ukumisa ukwelashwa kusenesikhathi lapho uzizwa ungcono. Ukwelashwa kancane kuzala i-TB engazweli emishanguzweni, okunzima kakhulu futhi okude ukuyelapha.

items.body: Izehlakalo ezintsha ze-TB eNingizimu Afrika minyaka yonke. Enye yamanani aphezulu kakhulu emhlabeni.

items.headline: 100% mahhala
items.body: Njalo ukuhlolwa, yonke ithebhulethi, njalo ukuvakasha. Ukwelashwa kwe-TB engazweli emishanguzweni nakho kumahhala. Ayikho i-medical aid edingekayo.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: Izinyanga eziyisi-6 zomuthi wansuku zonke zelapha i-TB ejwayelekile ngokuphelele. I-TB engazweli emishanguzweni ithatha isikhathi eside kodwa futhi iyelapheka.

items.headline: I-HIV iphinda kabili ingozi
items.body: I-TB iyimbangela ehamba phambili yokufa kwabantu abaphila ne-HIV. Uma une-HIV, hlolelwa i-TB njalo lapho uvakasha.

pull_quote.text: Ukumisa amaphilisi e-TB lapho uzizwa ungcono kuyinto eyingozi kakhulu ongayenza - kuwena kanye nakuwo wonke umuntu oseduze nawe. I-TB engazweli emishanguzweni iqala ngosuku umuntu ayeka ngalo imishanguzo yakhe.

signs.heading: Ongakubuka
signs.lede: I-TB ivamise ukukhula kancane. Isibonakaliso sakudala siwukukhwehlela okungeke kuphele. Noma yikuphi ukukhwehlela okuhlala isikhathi esingaphezu kwamaviki ama-2 kufanele kuhlolwe.

items.title: Ukukhwehlela okuqhubekayo
items.description: Ukukhwehlela okuhlala isikhathi esingaphezu kwamaviki ama-2, kuvame ukukhiqiza, kwesinye isikhathi kube negazi. Kungase kube kubi kakhulu ebusuku.

items.title: Ukujuluka ebusuku nomkhuhlane
items.description: Ukujuluka okumanzi ebusuku okucwilisa amashidi. Umkhuhlane wezinga eliphansi, ikakhulukazi ntambama nakusihlwa.

items.title: Ukuncipha kwesisindo nokukhathala
items.description: Ukuncipha kwesisindo okungaqondile emavikini noma izinyanga. Ukulahlekelwa ukudla. Ukukhathala okungahambisani nomsebenzi.

items.title: Ezinganeni
items.description: Ukuhluleka ukukhula kahle, ukukhuluphala ngokweqile, ukukhwehlela okungapheli, ukuvuvukala kwezindlala entanyeni. I-TB ezinganeni ivame ukuphuthelwa - buza ukuthi isihlobo esiseduze sine-TB.

spreads.heading: Indlela i-TB esabalala ngayo - nokuthi ayisakazeki kanjani
yes: Ukuphefumula amaconsi kumuntu one-TB yamaphaphu ephilayo oklinywayo noma othimula
Ukusondelana isikhathi eside ezindaweni ezivalekile, ezingenawo umoya ohlanzekile
Ukuhlala noma ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo eziminyene - amakhaya, amahostela, izimayini, amajele
Ukuphuza ubisi olungagcotshwanga ezinkomeni ezinegciwane (akuvamile eNingizimu Afrika)
no: Ukuthintana nje njengokuxhawula noma ukuba sendaweni efanayo yangaphandle
Ukwabelana ngokudla, iziphuzo, amapuleti, noma okokudla
Izihlalo zasendlini yangasese, izibankwa zomnyango, noma izingubo zokulala (uma sezivuliwe)

prevention.heading: Ungazivikela kanjani wena nomndeni wakho
prevention.lede: I-TB iyachuma ezindaweni ezingenawo umoya ohlanzekile, neziminyene. Ukuvimbela okuningi kumayelana nomoya, ukutholwa kusenesikhathi, kanye nokuqeda ukwelashwa — okwakho noma okomuntu othintana naye.

items.title: Umgomo we-BCG ngesikhathi sokuzalwa
items.description: Yonke ingane yaseNingizimu Afrika ijova i-BCG lapho izalwa. Ayivimbi yonke i-TB kodwa yehlisa izinhlobo ezinzima ezinganeni, ikakhulukazi i-meningitis.

items.title: Vula amawindi
items.description: Amagciwane e-TB afa ngokushesha emoyeni omusha kanye nasemisebeni yelanga. Vula amafasitela, ikakhulukazi emakamelweni okulala ahlala nomuntu olashelwa i-TB.

items.title: Hlola abathintwayo basekhaya
items.description: Uma othile ekhaya lakho exilongwa, wonke umuntu osendlini kufanele ahlolwe - ngisho noma ezizwa ephilile. Izingane zidinga isivikelo ikakhulukazi.

items.title: Ukwelashwa kokuvimbela i-TB
items.description: Abantu abaphila ne-HIV, abathintwayo basekhaya, namanye amaqembu asengozini banganikezwa inkambo yamaphilisi e-TB ukuvimbela izifo ezikhona. Buza emtholampilo wakho.

items.fact: I-TB ithinta wonke amaqembu aholayo. Amazinga aphezulu e-SA avela ekungeneni komoya kahle, ukuminyana, kanye nesixhumanisi se-HIV - kodwa noma ubani ochitha isikhathi endaweni evalekile ene-TB ephilayo uyadalulwa.

items.myth: Uma sengizizwa ngingcono, ngiyakwazi ukumisa amaphilisi.
items.fact: Ukuma kusenesikhathi yindlela i-TB engazweli emishanguzweni eqala ngayo. Kufanele uqedele izinyanga eziyisi-6 ezigcwele - ngisho nalapho ungasakhwehleli futhi usubuyile nesisindo.

items.myth: Amaphilisi e-TB alimaza isibindi nenhliziyo — amakhambi emvelo angcono.
items.fact: Amaphilisi e-TB awavamile ukuba nemiphumela emibi esibindini, eqashwayo. Kodwa i-TB engelashiwe iyabulala ngokuqinisekile. Alikho ikhambi lemvelo elake lamisa amagciwane e-TB.

items.myth: Uma udla kahle futhi uqinile, ungakwazi ukulwa ne-TB ngokwakho.
items.fact: Ukudla okunomsoco kusiza amasosha omzimba, kodwa akukho ukudla okukodwa okungamisa i-TB. Ama-antibiotics ukuphela kwendlela yokwelapha esebenzayo. Yidla kahle FUTHI uphuze amaphilisi.

items.title: Uma uke wakhwehlela amasonto ama-2 - hlolwa
items.description: Hamba uye kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo. Cela ukuhlolwa kwe-TB. Uzocelwa ukuthi ukhiphe isikhwehlela enkomishini encane. Imiphumela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbalwa.

items.title: Uma positive - qala ukwelashwa ngokushesha
items.description: Umtholampilo uzokunikeza amaphilisi ngalolo suku. Ukwelashwa kwansuku zonke, kugadwa esigabeni sokuqala, futhi mahhala.

items.title: Thatha wonke umthamo, nsuku zonke, izinyanga eziyi-6 ezigcwele
items.description: Ungalokothi weqe. Ungalokothi ume ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngisho nalapho uzizwa ungcono ngemva kwamaviki ambalwa. Ukweqa kuzala i-TB engazweli emishanguzweni.

items.title: Tshela umndeni wakho kanye nosondelene nabo
items.description: Kufanele zonke zihlolwe. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emi-5 kanye nabesifazane abakhulelwe ikakhulukazi badinga ukubonwa ngokushesha. Umtholampilo uyasiza ngokulandela umkhondo wokuxhumana nabantu.

items.title: Uma ukwelashelwa i-HIV - qhubeka kokubili
items.description: Ukwelashwa kwe-TB ne-HIV kusebenza ndawonye. Tshela umtholampilo ngayo yonke imithi yakho. Ungalokothi uyeke eyodwa ukuze wenze enye ibe lula.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa kwe-TB kungenye yezinhlelo ezisungulwe kakhulu empilweni yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Hamba uye kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo - akukho ukuqokwa, akukho sizo lwezokwelapha, akukho-ID edingekayo.
